## How to use it

- Go in order the first time: each chapter builds on the one before.
- Answer the checkpoint at the end of each chapter before moving on.
- Keep **Numbers to remember** open as a quick revision sheet before exams.
- Teachers are welcome to use it in class or set chapters as homework.
